scope: Existing single-host Linux Codex-first supported routes; explicit authenticated self-surrender and incident-grounded audit/review refinements. No new external adapter or project-wide model shutdown authority.

requirements.acceptance: Existing versioned events distinguish trusted requester/enforcer, actual resource/action, policy/grant/exact human approval, requirement versus performed review or exception, policy version, observation/recording time and ordering, and execution outcome. Unknown occurrence time stays unknown; worker text cannot fabricate approval. Pair human/automatic ordinary actions, policy change, delayed records and allow-but-failed effects. All checkpoint acceptance retains exact operator review.

Map/reuse existing native coverage for supported broker, command/child, delegate, registry resolution/build/import and preview paths; add missing combinations and fix admitted boundary defects. An unavailable target cannot widen scope; fetch cannot publish; credentials remain confined. Use disposable alternates, inert packages and collector/state oracles plus useful permitted controls. Unsupported routes stay disabled; no blanket claim that trusted transport or the whole host is offline.

One explicit authenticated self-surrender route across interactive/headless adapters reuses session closure and supervision. Persist closure, revoke caller subtree, reject old-token work/delegation/restart and late publication; repeated request is idempotent. Child cannot stop parent/sibling/unrelated project. Distinguish request, closed admission and confirmed physical termination. Lost ack, supervisor and required-audit/quota failures cannot reopen admission or falsely confirm stop. Best-effort termination survives admission faults. Ordinary conversation remains active; operator-authorized fresh protected continuation preserves scope/history. Native independent process/sentinel oracles and positive controls required.

Controller facts/authority/effects are distinct from optional worker narratives in review packets and summaries. Reassuring simulation/approval/success text cannot clear missing authority/evidence or alter mechanical outcomes. Use paired facts-identical rationale variant and authorized benign control. Preserve existing frozen eight-case/16-call maximum and report any semantic limitation; no automatic approval, extra model calls or replacing previously measured cases.

Include and verify all three immutable contracts, current scenario/review docs, per-ID original evidence, exact runtime hashes and installed new/existing project behavior. Normal full regression includes focused incident controls once without native skips. Local and published-candidate gate reject missing/stale/forged/mismatched amendment evidence and archives missing the additive contract.
